description: This file defines a service class 'UndoClientTransactionCommandHandler' that handles undo commands for client transactions within the Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' to process commands and uses the 'ClientTransactionWritePlatformService' to perform the undo operation.

classes.name: UndoClientTransactionCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class annotated with @Service, handling undo operations for client transactions by processing commands and delegating to the write platform service.

methods.name: UndoClientTransactionCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the ClientTransactionWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the undo command by invoking the 'undo' method on the write platform service with the client ID and entity ID extracted from the command.
